title: Pocketwire Personal Account Plan Multiplier — Advance Late Fees
content:
The plan of the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account bears on the late fees of the linked Pocketwire Advance line. When the linked personal account is on Pocketwire Summit, the late fee is multiplied by 0.8; when it is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Prime, the late fee is multiplied by 0.9; on any other plan no plan factor applies. The multiplier acts on the late fee of the period as the unpaid principal multiplied by the weekly rate gives it, before that late fee is rounded. The plan is the one the personal account's record shows.

| Personal account plan | Late fee multiplied by |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Summit | 0.8 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 0.9 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 0.9 |
| Pocketwire Plus | No multiplier |
| Pocketwire Core | No multiplier |
| Pocketwire Lite | No multiplier |

Illustration (hypothetical): a late fee that the unpaid principal and the weekly rate put at 2.40 before rounding becomes 1.92 for a customer on Pocketwire Summit and 2.16 for a customer on Pocketwire Onyx, and stays 2.40 for a customer on Pocketwire Plus.
